entities.summary: Feofaniya Clinical Hospital is a hospital of State Management of Affairs of Ukraine which designated to provide medical service to Ukrainian officials. It is located on the southern outskirts of Kyiv next to village of Novosilky of Fastiv Raion. Next to the hospital also is located the Main Astronomical Observatory of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine.
